tree.text: The term “agency” includes any entity, organizational unit, program, or function.
The term “transition period” means the 12-month period beginning on the effective date of this chapter.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The effective date of this chapter, referred to in par. (2), is 60 days after Nov. 25, 2002, see section 4 of Pub. L. 107–296, set out as an Effective Date note under section 101 of this title.
